scope: One bounded P4 improvement-cycle composition in which the Agent selected repository observations from an admitted capability catalog without caller-preselected source slices or evaluator gates, two target finalizations were denied because their own falsifiers did not produce causal baseline-red evidence, and a corrected experiment protocol allowed the Agent to terminate with an explicit bounded no-target/no-source-mutation outcome. This is evidence for Agent-owned discovery composition plus lawful abstention, not a claim that Harness is defect-free or an autonomous indefinite RSI controller.

metaFalsifier.claim: The P4 experiment protocol could not represent a bounded no-target terminal outcome because discovery admitted only observe or finalize-with-target.
metaFalsifier.baselineFailure: P4_PROTOCOL_CANNOT_TERMINATE_NO_TARGET: discovery status admits only observe/finalize

agentOwnedDiscovery.epistemicBoundary: No causal baseline-red source target was demonstrated under the Agent-selected observations. This does not claim that Harness has no remaining defects or is globally correct.

causalTargetAdmission.interpretation: A plausible or confident target does not earn mutation authority. Exact causal baseline-red remains the asymmetric admission requirement for changing source.

noChangeAuthority.reason: No target survived causal baseline admission; invoking downstream mutation/promotion authorities would have fabricated work rather than preserved authority separation.
noChangeAuthority.law: Source mutation requires causal baseline-red; bounded abstention requires exact provenance plus an explicit uncertainty boundary, not proof of global correctness.

checks: only experiment scaffolding dirty before cleanup

improvementOfImprovement.interpretation: The improvement mechanism learned that no-change is a first-class valid outcome. This removes defect-hunting pressure without weakening source-mutation admission.

remainingBoundaries: P4 is a bounded capability-composition/no-change instance, not autonomous indefinite recursive self-improvement.
The discovery runner and abstain protocol remain experiment scaffolding and are not supported Harness APIs.

The successful no-target branch did not exercise a surviving Agent-authored evaluator specification, source edit, candidate evaluator, promotion decision or Git source promotion; those authorities remain separate and intentionally uninvoked.

Discovery efficiency remains poor: 203 observations and near-complete source reading were required before the protocol admitted abstention. P4 proves authority semantics, not efficient repository search.
Cycle triggering and canonical documentation/evidence promotion remain external.
No Scheduler, Goal Stream, generic Evaluator Service, Memory/RAG subsystem, DAG, RSI Controller or second persistence layer was forced.
